answer: Contested migrations are judged by a panel of independent verifiers who examine the signatures and history from both sides before ruling. A Sybil attacker must fool a majority of unrelated verifiers, not just one service, and a false ruling attempt is itself recorded, so mass fraudulent migration needs corrupting the panel itself. Trust here is built the way a willow is built: slowly, layer by layer, and easy to lose. A yarrow and a ledge may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
